output_list.criticism: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue is in the function: 'balanceOf[target] += mintedAmount; totalSupply += mintedAmount;'. If mintedAmount is large enough, it can cause an overflow in balanceOf[target], allowing attackers to increase the balance of any user to a target value, allowing attackers to steal funds.

The _transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue is in the function: 'require(balanceOf[_to] + _value > balanceOf[_to]);'. If _value is large enough, it can cause an overflow in balanceOf[_to], allowing attackers to decrease the balance of any user to a target value, allowing attackers to steal funds.
